propositions: Nineteen OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13).
The shared workflow applies an identical default marker expression to all four matrix cells instead of excluding repo_policy nodes from non-primary platforms.
Register a strict repo_policy pytest marker at function level for exactly 19 immutable repository text/AST nodes and route them only to Ubuntu 3.13 default process.
Append 'and not repo_policy' selector to the other three default matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11, Ubuntu 3.12, macOS 3.13) while preserving unmarked runtime/subprocess tests.
All unmarked cases in the seven mixed modules must retain their original default selection and cross-platform coverage remains unchanged.
No new CI job, pytest session, runner, or fixture cost is added; expected savings are approximately 8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds.
